talk.speaker: villager
talk.text: My cousin went into the woods with that stranger three days ago. Not a word since.

talk.speaker: villager
talk.text: If you're going east, please, bring him back.

then.speaker: marta
then.text: Come in, come in. Mind the stools.

then.speaker: marta
then.text: That stranger knocked on my door too. Said I'd never want for anything again.

then.speaker: marta
then.text: I told him I already don't. He didn't like that.

else.speaker: marta
else.text: Back again? The kettle's always on.

talk.speaker: marta
talk.prompt: Anything I can do for you?

options.label: Could we rest here a while?

steps.speaker: marta
steps.text: Of course. Sit, all of you.
The party rests. Everyone is back to full health.

steps.speaker: marta
steps.text: East, down the road and into the woods. Where else do people vanish?

talk.speaker: bridgeKeeper
talk.text: I've been seeing a lot of people go into the forest lately, they look... enchanted somehow? Last night I saw a band of thugs entering as well. Is this connected to people disappearing? They gave me the creeps.
